# Generated by tools/import_dop_cabinet.py; biographies are in docs/sources/.

DOP_GNG_apply_cabinet_lee = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee } }
			remove_all_ministers = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = GNG_morita_akio } }
				recruit_character = GNG_morita_akio
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = GNG_li_kashing } }
				recruit_character = GNG_li_kashing
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = DOP_GNG_yamashita_toshihiko } }
				recruit_character = DOP_GNG_yamashita_toshihiko
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = GNG_stanley_ho } }
				recruit_character = GNG_stanley_ho
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_character = GNG_omori_kan } }
				recruit_character = GNG_omori_kan
			}
			promote_character = GNG_morita_akio
			set_politics = { ruling_party = paternalism }
			set_country_leader_description = { desc = "DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee_leader_desc" }
			GNG_li_kashing = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_advisor_role = head_of_government }
					remove_advisor_role = { slot = head_of_government }
				}
				add_advisor_role = {
					advisor = {
						slot = head_of_government
						idea_token = DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee_li_kashing_head_of_government
						allowed = { original_tag = GNG }
						traits = { head_of_government hog_the_co_custodian }
						ledger = civilian
						cost = -1
						can_be_fired = no
						ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
					}
					activate = yes
				}
			}
			DOP_GNG_yamashita_toshihiko = {
				set_portraits = { civilian = { small = "GFX_DOP_GNG_minister_Yamashita_Toshihiko" } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_advisor_role = foreign_minister }
					remove_advisor_role = { slot = foreign_minister }
				}
				add_advisor_role = {
					advisor = {
						slot = foreign_minister
						idea_token = DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee_yamashita_toshihiko_foreign_minister
						allowed = { original_tag = GNG }
						traits = { foreign_minister }
						ledger = civilian
						cost = -1
						can_be_fired = no
						ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
					}
					activate = yes
				}
			}
			GNG_stanley_ho = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_advisor_role = economy_minister }
					remove_advisor_role = { slot = economy_minister }
				}
				add_advisor_role = {
					advisor = {
						slot = economy_minister
						idea_token = DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee_stanley_ho_economy_minister
						allowed = { original_tag = GNG }
						traits = { economy_minister eco_man_of_many_talents }
						ledger = civilian
						cost = -1
						can_be_fired = no
						ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
					}
					activate = yes
				}
			}
			GNG_omori_kan = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_advisor_role = security_minister }
					remove_advisor_role = { slot = security_minister }
				}
				add_advisor_role = {
					advisor = {
						slot = security_minister
						idea_token = DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee_omori_kan_security_minister
						allowed = { original_tag = GNG }
						traits = { security_minister sec_a_wind_of_change }
						ledger = civilian
						cost = -1
						can_be_fired = no
						ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
					}
					activate = yes
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee
			clr_country_flag = DOP_GNG_cabinet_ibuka
			clr_country_flag = DOP_GNG_cabinet_finance
			clr_country_flag = DOP_GNG_cabinet_1962
			clr_country_flag = DOP_GNG_cabinet_military
			set_country_flag = DOP_GNG_cabinet_lee
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: DOP cabinet installed: lee"
		}
	}
}

DOP_GNG_sync_cabinet = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_focus_tree = dop_sonyjapan_ending1_lee_tree }
		DOP_GNG_apply_cabinet_lee = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_focus_tree = dop_sonyjapan_ending2_ibuka_tree }
		DOP_GNG_apply_cabinet_ibuka = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_focus_tree = dop_sonyjapan_ending3_hitachi_tree }
		DOP_GNG_apply_cabinet_finance = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_focus_tree = dop_sonyjapan_ending4_return1962_tree }
		DOP_GNG_apply_cabinet_1962 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_focus_tree = dop_sonyjapan_ending5_second_roit_tree }
		DOP_GNG_apply_cabinet_military = yes
	}
}
